t: Short web map activities for grades 4 to 12 from Esri.
steps: Find the GeoInquiries gallery from Esri in a browser.
Open a Level 1 activity and try it yourself.
Request a free school ArcGIS Online organization for Level 2.
Give students at least Publisher permissions.
Read the Esri privacy terms with your school.
Pick one activity to run with a class.
